body.name: \(\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}\)
body.construction: Let \(I_{\mathrm{const}}\) be the coordinates whose circuits simplify symbolically to constants.  Put \(\delta_n=n^{-1/2}+\max_{r\in\mathcal R}|n_r/n-\rho_r|\), and fix a deterministic \(\kappa_n>0\) such that \(\kappa_n\to0\) and \(\delta_n/\kappa_n\to0\).  Let \(\widehat\Sigma_Q\) be the covariance formula with \(p\) and \(\rho_r\) replaced by \(\widehat p\) and \(n_r/n\), and set \(\widehat I_+=\{j\notin I_{\mathrm{const}}:\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}>\kappa_n\}\).  Conditional on \(\widehat I_+\ne\varnothing\), let \(c_{1-\alpha}\) be the \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile of \(\max_{j\in\widehat I_+}|Z_j|/\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}}\) for \(Z\sim N(0,\widehat\Sigma_{Q,\widehat I_+,\widehat I_+})\), and report \(\widehat Q_j\pm c_{1-\alpha}\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}/n}\) simultaneously for \(j\in\widehat I_+\).  Report every \(j\in I_{\mathrm{const}}\) as its exact symbolic equality and every remaining excluded coordinate as first-order degenerate without a Wald interval.  If \(\widehat I_+=\varnothing\), no Gaussian region is formed.
